summary_en: OSG Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 1,500,000 shares (1.80% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 13 to November 30, 2026, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, the Board of Directors of OSG Corporation resolved to acquire treasury shares pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 165, Paragraph 3). The acquisition is authorized up to a maximum of 1,500,000 shares, representing 1.80% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026 (83,193,345 shares), for a maximum consideration of 5.0 billion yen.

The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-hours trading, during the period from October 13, 2026 to November 30, 2026. The company stated that the acquisition aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. Execution of the acquisition is subject to market conditions, and the company may not execute orders in full or in part depending on market circumstances.
